name: Recurring Payment Data 1
definition: Contains detail information of the recurring payment.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Code to indicate the recurring payment type. The valid value refer to the ISO 8583 bit 104 Dataset 18/88 tag 80/2.

PerTransactionAmountIndicator.name: Per Transaction Amount Indicator
PerTransactionAmountIndicator.definition: Indicate the type of payment amount per transaction. Valid value refer to ISO 8583 bit 104 dataset 18/88 tag 81/3.

NumberOfRecurringPayment.name: Number Of Recurring Payment
NumberOfRecurringPayment.definition: Contain the number of recurring payment.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Indicate the frequency of the recurring payment. The valid value refer to the ISO 8583 bit 104 Dataset 18/88 tag 83/5.

RegistrationReferenceNumber.name: Registration Reference Number
RegistrationReferenceNumber.definition: Reference number of the recurring payment agreement assigned by the merchant.

MaximumRecurringPaymentAmount.name: Maximum Recurring Payment Amount
MaximumRecurringPaymentAmount.definition: Contain the maximum recurring payment amount.

ValidationIndicator.name: Validation Indicator
ValidationIndicator.definition: Indicate whether the recurring payment agreement validated or not. The valid value refer to the ISO 8583 bit 104 Dataset 18/88 tag 86/8.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
